en: Black‑and‑white photograph of an elaborate Renaissance-style monumental tomb inside a church. The multi-tiered sarcophagus is richly decorated with columns, reliefs, and numerous small statues of kneeling and standing figures. On the upper level there are recumbent lion figures, and on the very top stands a large statue of a man in armor with a sword, next to a tall crucifix with Christ on the cross. The monument is elevated on steps and partly roped off. Gothic vaults and church décor are visible in the background.
